pass_rule: 70/100 with no unresolved critical factual or privacy failure.
calibration: Calibrate against at least 30 founder reviewed samples before relying on automatic passing.

criteria.evidence: Clear goal, intended user and useful output.
Claims checked, sources valid, calculations or logic inspected.
Reproducible steps, sensible constraints and revision rationale.
Readable, coherent, usable final work with suitable media.
Appropriate data, asset rights, limitations and explanation of choices.
